Inline Fixture

The harbour was founded by fishermen and later grew into the largest port on the coast, and as of 2020, the harbour handles more cargo than any other port in the region, according to the yearly report published by the port authority for its members.

The first warehouses were built of timber and stood along the northern quay until the great fire of the winter destroyed them, after which the merchants rebuilt every one of them in stone at their own expense.

The old town was renamed Harbourton (lit. 'Eastern Harbour') when the railway reached it, and its earlier name (Edo) is now used only by the oldest residents of the quarter.
